Ezreal.build: Prioritize movement speed to dodge Ezreal's long-range poke and help close the gap. Ezreal Q Mystic Shot deals physical damage, while Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift deal magic damage, so don't build only one type of resistance. Also account for effects that reduce attack speed.
Ezreal.combo: Hit Ezreal with Smolder W Achooo! to slow him and gain a stack, then use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, stop trading and back off. If Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down and you can pursue, use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to close the gap.
Ezreal.escape: Right after you force Ezreal to use Ezreal E Arcane Shift is your window to engage. Repeated hits from Ezreal Q Mystic Shot make Ezreal E Arcane Shift come back sooner, so close the gap briefly with minions between you. If you get into danger, slow Ezreal with Smolder W Achooo! and cross a wall with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. If needed, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet to heal.
Ezreal.fight: Early on, focus on last hits with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath instead of starting fights. To trade, hit Ezreal with Smolder W Achooo!, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. Just after Ezreal E Arcane Shift is used is a chance to close the gap, but use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap carefully since you also need it to survive.
Ezreal.laning: Keep minions between you and Ezreal to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. Before the first evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath, let the wave push toward you and farm last hits and permanent stacks near your turret. Use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath between last hits on minions to recover mana instead of repeatedly using it to poke Ezreal.
Ezreal.phase: In the mid game, each evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath improves his waveclear and contribution to fights. Smolder grows strong late with accumulated stacks, so even when behind, it's better to keep stacking than to fight.
Ezreal.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep using Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the nearest enemy. Evolved Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath spreads damage to nearby enemies, so don't overextend to chase Ezreal. Even if Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down and you have a chance to catch him, consider whether to save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap as an escape.
Ezreal.watch: Move within the wave because minions block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, briefly move out of range to avoid the bonus damage from his next attack. When low on health, don't retreat in a straight line where Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage can hit you.

Draven.fight: Don't fight Draven while he has two axes. Look to trade when he has only one or has dropped them all. Hitting him with Smolder W Achooo! where an axe will land can slow him and make it harder to catch the axe. If W misses, give up the trade and back off.
Draven.laning: Early on, let the wave push toward you and farm near your turret with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. The Smolder P Dragon Practice stacks from Q last hits are permanent, so keep stacking steadily even in a losing lane. If you farm safely without giving Draven a kill, your jungler will have an opening to gank him when he steps forward.
Draven.build: Buy Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Draven deals mostly physical damage and Smolder has relatively low armor, so prioritize armor.
Draven.combo: Aim Smolder W Achooo! where an axe will land to slow Draven. If it hits, follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Draven gets on top of you, slow him with Smolder W Achooo! and escape over a wall with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. If you need to hold out longer, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet for a slow and healing.
Draven.escape: Draven has no mobility to create distance, so look to close the gap when Draven E Stand Aside is down and he has few axes. You can approach with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, but it's your only escape, so if there's a risk of a gank, save it rather than using it to engage.
Draven.phase: In the mid game, each evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath improves his waveclear and contribution to fights. Secure vision and objectives when you gain priority. Smolder grows strong late with stacks and items, so the further behind you are, the more you should choose farming over forced fights.
Draven.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep using Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the nearest enemy in range. Slow Draven where he will catch an axe with Smolder W Achooo! or Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! to disrupt his axe upkeep and attacks. Save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to survive. If you're in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet to heal.
Draven.watch: Avoid early trades while Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axe, since his empowered basic attacks are dangerous. Draven W Blood Rush grants movement and attack speed, and its cooldown can reset, so don't assume you're safe just because he's used it once. Draven R Whirling Death can deal damage and execute on its return path, so get completely clear of its round-trip path.

Aphelios.teamfight: Spread out from allies so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil doesn't hit several of you. Stay behind your frontline and keep using Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the nearest enemy in range. Save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to survive. If you're in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet for a slow and healing.
Aphelios.build: Buy Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Since Aphelios deals mostly physical damage, prioritize armor. If healing is enough to keep undoing Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath's damage over time, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Aphelios.combo: Hit Aphelios with Smolder W Achooo! to slow him and gain a stack, then use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, stop trading and save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to disengage.
Aphelios.escape: Look for an opening when Aphelios doesn't have Gravitum, so you have less reason to worry about the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites, and when he also doesn't have Severum. You can use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to close the gap, but it's your only escape, so use it only when you can safely get back out.
Aphelios.fight: Look for trades when Aphelios has a weapon with low burst damage. Hit him with Smolder W Achooo!, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If W misses, back off.
Aphelios.laning: Early on, let the wave push toward you and farm near your turret with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath while stacking Smolder P Dragon Practice. Back away when Aphelios has Calibrum so its mark doesn't cost you health. Once the first evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath speeds up waveclear, secure vision and objectives.
Aphelios.phase: Smolder is weak early, so focus on farming to stack Smolder P Dragon Practice instead of fighting. In the mid game, each evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath improves his waveclear and teamfight contribution. Smolder gains the advantage as he builds stacks and items into the late game.
Aphelios.watch: When Aphelios is holding Gravitum through Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and a basic attack applies its slow, immediately move out of his range to avoid the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil only detonates when it hits a champion, so spread out from allies. Also move away when marked by Calibrum to avoid the follow-up attack.

Kalista.combo: Look for the moment Kalista starts an attack animation and hit her first with Smolder W Achooo! If it misses, don’t chase; back away.
Kalista.build: Use Cloth Armor to get through the early game. Kalista’s main damage is physical, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Kalista.escape: While Kalista R Fate’s Call is down, she can’t throw her support to engage, giving you a chance to close the gap. Also look for a fight when the slow from Kalista E Rend is unavailable, but back away first if several spears are lodged in you. To escape, slow her with Smolder W Achooo!, then cross a wall with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. If needed, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet to heal.
Kalista.fight: When Kalista starts a basic-attack animation, predict her leap direction and throw Smolder W Achooo! there. If it hits, follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks; if it misses, back away. There’s an opportunity to close the gap while Kalista R Fate’s Call is down, but Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is also needed to escape, so use it carefully.
Kalista.laning: Early on, pull the wave toward you and last-hit near your turret with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath while stacking Smolder P Dragon Practice. If several of Kalista’s spears are lodged in you, manage your health conservatively and leave lane if needed. Once Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath evolves for the first time and clears waves faster, secure vision and objectives.
Kalista.phase: Smolder is weak early, so don’t force fights with Kalista; stack with last hits from Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. In the mid game, take wave control as Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath evolves. Smolder gets stronger later with accumulated stacks and items, so keep dealing damage from a safe position.
Kalista.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep using Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the nearest enemy in range. Spread out if Kalista’s support stays beside her, in case of Kalista R Fate’s Call. Save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap for survival, and if you’re in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your position to gain a slow and heal.
Kalista.watch: Watch out for the physical damage from Kalista Q Pierce and Kalista E Rend. If several spears are lodged in you, Kalista E Rend can take a large chunk of your health, so stop fighting and back away until the spears disappear. Spread out when Kalista’s contracted support stays close to her, in case of Kalista R Fate’s Call.

Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and reaches farther than its displayed range, so move out of the line behind a minion when Lucian farms with Q. When Lucian R The Culling starts, move sideways instead of running straight back. If Lucian receives a shield or heal, or a member of your team is immobilized, his next two shots are empowered, so avoid trading.
Lucian.build: Lucian’s main damage is physical and Smolder has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Lucian.combo: After Lucian’s abilities are down, hit with Smolder W Achooo! to slow and explode on him, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, give up the trade and back away.
Lucian.escape: The moment after you force Lucian to use E Relentless Pursuit is a window to close the gap. You can use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to go in during that opening, but it’s your only escape, so save it when you may need it to avoid a gank.
Lucian.fight: Let Lucian’s first combo pass, then retaliate after his abilities are down. There’s a brief opening just after Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, but extended basic-attack trades let E come back quickly, so keep trades short. Follow up with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks only when Smolder W Achooo! hits.
Lucian.laning: Early on, pull the wave toward your turret and last-hit near it with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath while stacking Smolder P Dragon Practice. Don’t stand directly behind a minion in Lucian Q Piercing Light’s path. Once Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath evolves for the first time and clears waves faster, secure vision and objectives.
Lucian.phase: In the mid game, Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath’s evolutions improve your wave clear and teamfight contribution. Smolder has the advantage later as stacks and items accumulate, so keep stacking even when behind.
Lucian.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep using Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the nearest enemy in range. If Lucian R The Culling is aimed at you, move sideways. If you’re in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your position to gain a slow and heal.

Samira.escape: If Samira E Wild Rush and the enemy support’s engage ability are down, you have a window to attack while Samira can’t reset her dash. Use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap only when you can close the gap safely; otherwise, save it to escape.
Samira.build: Use Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Samira’s main damage is physical and Smolder has low armor, so build armor first.
Samira.combo: Wait for the spin from Samira W Blade Whirl to end, then hit her with Smolder W Achooo!.
Samira.fight: Hit Samira with Smolder W Achooo! to slow her and gain a stack, then make a short trade with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, stop trading. If Samira uses E Wild Rush and no one dies, you have a chance to attack her.
Samira.laning: Early on, pull the wave toward your turret and last-hit near it with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath to gain permanent stacks. Keep your distance so Samira can’t walk up into melee range. After Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath’s first evolution speeds up wave clear, secure vision and objectives.
Samira.phase: In the mid game, each evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath improves your wave clear and teamfight contribution. Later, use your accumulated stacks to deal sustained damage from behind your frontline.
Samira.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and repeatedly use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the nearest enemy in range. If Samira gets onto an ally, create distance with the slow from Smolder W Achooo!, and save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to survive. If you’re in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your position to heal and slow.
Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, it destroys projectiles and basic attacks, so attack after the spin ends. If you’re hit by the enemy support’s crowd control, Samira can close in with Samira P Daredevil Impulse, so dodge the engage ability first. When Samira gets close and starts building style, create distance to deny her time to cast Samira R Inferno Trigger.

Kaisa.phase: Smolder is weak early, so prioritize survival and last hits with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath against Kai'Sa. In the mid game, each evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath improves his waveclear and contribution to fights. Smolder gains the advantage late with stacks and items, so deal damage safely from the backline.
Kaisa.build: Buy Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor to mitigate the physical damage from Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain and her basic attacks.
Kaisa.combo: Hit Kai'Sa with Smolder W Achooo! to slow her and gain a stack, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Kai'Sa approaches and you need to disengage, slow her with Smolder W Achooo! and fly over a wall you've chosen in advance with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. If your health is critical, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet to heal.
Kaisa.escape: Even then, confirm that Smolder W Achooo! hits before trading, and use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to escape if you get into danger.
Kaisa.fight: Keep a safe distance, then take a short trade with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks when Smolder W Achooo! hits Kai'Sa. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, give up the trade. While Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, but first make sure you have a way to get back out.
Kaisa.laning: Early on, let the wave push toward you and farm near your turret with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath for last hits and permanent stacks. Once the first evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath lets you clear waves quickly, secure vision and objectives.
Kaisa.teamfight: Stand behind your frontline and use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the nearest enemy in range. If Kai'Sa dives in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, create distance with the slow from Smolder W Achooo! and Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. If enemies group up, hit the center with Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!; if you're in danger, cast it at your feet to heal.
Kaisa.watch: If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, you may become a target for Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, so move back toward your allies until the mark disappears. When you take Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, stand beside allied minions so the damage is spread out. If stacks of Kai'Sa P Second Skin build up, the lower the health, the greater the danger, so wait out the stacks from outside her range.

Jhin.phase: In the mid game, Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath makes a bigger difference in wave clear and teamfight impact each time it evolves. If you survive the early game and build stacks and items, the matchup increasingly favors Smolder as the game goes on.
Jhin.build: Buy Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Since Jhin deals mostly physical damage, prioritize armor.
Jhin.combo: Start the trade by hitting Jhin with Smolder W Achooo!, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, stop trading and back off. If you get into danger, slow him with Smolder W Achooo! and cross a wall with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. If needed, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet to heal.
Jhin.escape: Look to close the gap while Jhin W Deadly Flourish is down and Jhin is reloading. Jhin has no ability to create distance, so use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to approach when it's safe.
Jhin.fight: Look to trade when Jhin runs out of bullets and reloads, or just after he fires one or two shots. Hit him with Smolder W Achooo! to slow him and gain a stack, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Jhin W Deadly Flourish is down and you can safely close the gap, you can use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to approach. Save it as an escape when you need to be ready for a gank.
Jhin.laning: Early on, let the wave push toward you and farm near your turret with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath for last hits and permanent stacks. Jhin Q Dancing Grenade can bounce stronger after a kill, so stand a step away from low-health minions. Once the first evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath lets you clear waves quickly, secure vision and objectives.
Jhin.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep using Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on nearby enemies in range. Save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to survive. When approaching Jhin, let your frontline take Jhin W Deadly Flourish and Jhin R Curtain Call shots first. If low on health, dodge Jhin R Curtain Call; if you're in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet for a slow and healing.
Jhin.watch: The last shot of Jhin P Whisper deals heavy damage, so back off while he still has it. Right after you're hit by Jhin's basic attack or step on a Jhin E Captive Audience trap, watch out for the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish and move out of its line. When low on health, dodge Jhin R Curtain Call shots, especially the last one.

Ashe.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game. Ashe deals mostly physical damage and Smolder has low armor, so prioritize armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Ashe.combo: Trade by hitting Ashe with Smolder W Achooo!, then following with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Ashe's slow catches you, slow her with Smolder W Achooo! and escape over a wall with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. If needed, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet to heal.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no mobility, so look to close the gap after Ashe W Volley is used. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is also down and you don't need to disengage, use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to close the gap. Keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, then move in once it ends.
Ashe.fight: Start a trade just after Ashe W Volley is used, when you have an angle to hit her with Smolder W Achooo!. If it hits, follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If it misses, back off.
Ashe.laning: Early on, let the wave push toward you and farm near your turret with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath while stacking Smolder P Dragon Practice. Dodge Ashe W Volley sideways, but don't walk up to start a trade if it means missing last hits. Once the first evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath lets it damage nearby targets, clear the wave and secure vision and objectives.
Ashe.phase: In the mid game, use each evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath to improve your waveclear and find more chances to fight. Smolder grows stronger in the late game with stacks and items, so prioritize farming for stacks over fighting, even when behind.
Ashe.teamfight: Position behind your frontline and use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the nearest enemy in range. Don't walk too far forward to reach Ashe, and save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to survive. If the enemy team groups up, hit the center with Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!; if you're in danger, cast it at your feet.
Ashe.watch: Ashe P Frost Shot's slow is refreshed by every basic attack, so don't stay in her basic attack range for long. Dodge Ashe W Volley sideways. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don't start a small skirmish from outside vision.

Caitlyn.build: Buy Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Since Caitlyn deals mostly physical damage and Smolder has low armor, prioritize armor.
Caitlyn.combo: When you have an angle that avoids Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, hit her first with Smolder W Achooo! to slow her and gain a stack. If it hits, follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If it misses, stop the combo.
Caitlyn.escape: You can use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to close the gap during that opening, but it's your only escape, so save it if there's a risk of a gank.
Caitlyn.fight: Hit an enemy champion with Smolder W Achooo!, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, back off.
Caitlyn.laning: Don't take reckless risks and give up a kill early. Let the wave push toward you and farm near your turret with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. The Smolder P Dragon Practice stacks gained from those last hits are permanent, so prioritize farming over trading.
Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn is strong early, so Smolder should hold out near his turret and stack. In the mid game, each evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath improves his waveclear and teamfight contribution. Smolder gains the advantage late with stacks and items, so choose farming over fighting even when behind.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the nearest enemy in range. Watch for Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap in narrow passages where she might place one, and save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to survive. If you're in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet for a slow and healing.
Caitlyn.watch: If you step on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, you'll be rooted and take heavy damage from the increased range of Caitlyn P Headshot. Watch for traps in bushes and narrow passages. When dodging Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker, stand behind allied minions so they take the hit first.

Jinx.build: Buy Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Jinx deals mostly physical damage and Smolder has low armor, so prioritize armor.
Jinx.combo: When Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down, hit Jinx first with Smolder W Achooo!. Follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks, and save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to disengage.
Jinx.escape: Look to close the gap when Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down or Jinx W Zap! misses. You can approach with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, but it's your only escape, so save it if there's a risk of a gank. To get away, slow Jinx with Smolder W Achooo!, cross a wall with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, and, if needed, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet to heal.
Jinx.fight: Look to trade when Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down or Jinx W Zap! misses. Hit her with Smolder W Achooo! to slow her and gain a stack, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, back off.
Jinx.laning: Early on, let the wave push toward you and farm near your turret with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath while stacking Smolder P Dragon Practice. Avoid standing right next to minions when Jinx last-hits them with rockets. Once the first evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath starts damaging nearby targets, use the faster waveclear to secure vision and objectives.
Jinx.phase: In the mid game, each evolution of Smolder Q improves his waveclear and teamfight contribution. Smolder gains the advantage as he builds stacks and items into the late game, so keep farming even when behind.
Jinx.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep using Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the nearest enemy in range. Save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to survive. If the enemy team groups up, hit the center with Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!. Don't start a fight right after Jinx P Get Excited! triggers from a takedown or structure destruction.
Jinx.watch: Jinx Q Switcheroo!'s rockets also damage targets around their target, so don't stand on top of minions. Jinx E Flame Chompers! can root you and put you in danger, so don't approach recklessly while the traps are active. If health has been lost, watch out for the missing-health damage from Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! and stay out of its range.

KogMaw.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Kog’Maw Q Caustic Spittle, Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and Kog’Maw E Void Ooze. His basic attacks also deal substantial physical damage, so get some armor too. Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage deals damage based on max health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
KogMaw.combo: After Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends, hit first with Smolder W Achooo!, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, abandon the trade and back away. When you need to escape, slow him with Smolder W Achooo! and cross a wall with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. If needed, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet to heal.
KogMaw.escape: Kog’Maw has no mobility ability, so your chance to approach comes when you avoid the slow from Kog’Maw E Void Ooze and Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage has ended. You can close the gap with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, but it is also your way to escape a gank, so use your judgment before spending it.
KogMaw.fight: Wait for Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage to end before trading. Hit the champion with Smolder W Achooo! to slow them and gain a stack, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. Kog’Maw has no mobility ability, but Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is your only escape, so consider how you’ll get out before using it to engage.
KogMaw.laning: Early on, pull the wave instead of stepping forward to start a trade, and last-hit with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath to gain permanent stacks. Recover mana with Q last hits and weave champion poke between them. Once Q evolves for the first time and starts damaging nearby enemies, use your faster wave clear to secure vision and objectives.
KogMaw.phase: In the mid game, each evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath greatly improves your wave clear and teamfight contribution. Both champions get stronger over time, but Smolder gains more of an advantage the longer he holds out through the early game and builds stacks, so keep farming even when behind.
KogMaw.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the nearest enemy in range. Evolved Q’s damage spreads around its target, so don’t step too far forward just to reach Kog’Maw. Save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap for survival. If the enemy team groups up, hit the center with Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!; if you’re in danger, cast it at your position to heal.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog’Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, its range and max-health damage increase, so keep your distance until it ends. Block Kog’Maw Q Caustic Spittle with minions or sidestep it; if it hits, don’t fight while your armor and magic resistance are reduced. When low on health, get out of sight and heal to avoid Kog’Maw R Living Artillery. After killing Kog’Maw, move away from his corpse to avoid the explosion from Kog’Maw P Icathian Surprise.

MissFortune.build: Use Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Miss Fortune’s main damage is physical and Smolder has low armor, so build armor first.
MissFortune.combo: Hit Miss Fortune with Smolder W Achooo! to slow her and gain a stack, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, don’t go in further. When you need to escape, slow her with Smolder W Achooo! and cross a wall with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. If needed, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet to heal.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility ability, so close the gap with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap after the slow area from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain disappears and you can approach safely. However, Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is Smolder’s only escape, so don’t use it to engage when you need it to avoid a gank.
MissFortune.fight: Hit the champion with Smolder W Achooo!, then trade with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, give up the trade and back away. Miss Fortune has no mobility ability to create distance, so use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to close in when you can do so safely.
MissFortune.laning: Early on, pull the wave toward your turret and last-hit near it with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath to gain permanent stacks. Immediately after Miss Fortune hits a minion, create some distance, and don’t stand directly behind a minion where Miss Fortune Q Double Up can bounce onto you. Once Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath evolves and starts damaging nearby enemies, make use of your faster wave clear.
MissFortune.phase: In the mid game, each evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath improves your wave clear and teamfight contribution. Smolder gets stronger later with accumulated stacks and items, so the further behind you are, the more you should prioritize farming for stacks over fighting.
MissFortune.teamfight: Don’t start a fight in the area affected by Miss Fortune E Make It Rain; move outside it. Stay behind your frontline and use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the nearest enemy in range. If the enemy team groups up, hit the center with Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!. Move to the side of Miss Fortune R Bullet Time’s cone, and save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to survive.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces behind minions, so don’t stand in a line with them. If Miss Fortune E Make It Rain lands, you can be slowed and hit by Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, so move out of the area. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, move to the side of its fixed cone instead of only retreating backward.

Nilah.build: Use Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Nilah’s main damage is physical, so build armor first, but also build health to account for the penetration from Nilah Q Formless Blade. If healing keeps undoing Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath’s damage, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Nilah.combo: If Nilah engages, slow her with Smolder W Achooo! and create distance. After Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil have been fully spent, hit with Smolder W Achooo! and follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, respond with ability damage instead of basic attacks or wait for its effect to end.
Nilah.escape: Nilah E Slipstream has a short cooldown, so don’t use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to engage just because E is down. After Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil have been fully spent, you have a window to trade, but save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap as an escape. If you’re at risk of being caught, slow her with Smolder W Achooo! and cross a wall with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. If needed, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet to heal.
Nilah.fight: Early on, keep your distance and scale instead of starting fights. After Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil have been fully spent, trade with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks if Smolder W Achooo! hits. If it misses, abandon the trade and back away.
Nilah.laning: Smolder is weak early, so pull the wave toward your turret and last-hit near it with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. Stacks from last hits on Smolder P Dragon Practice are permanent, so don’t miss last hits even while avoiding unfavorable trades. Once Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath evolves for the first time and clears waves faster, secure vision and objectives.
Nilah.phase: Smolder is weak early, so avoid Nilah’s engages while building Smolder P Dragon Practice stacks. In the mid game, make use of faster wave clear as Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath evolves. Smolder gets strong later with accumulated stacks and items, so keep dealing damage from a safe position.
Nilah.teamfight: If Nilah has R Apotheosis, keep your distance from allies and stand behind your frontline. When Nilah goes in and uses Nilah W Jubilant Veil, attack the nearest enemy in range with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. Save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap for survival, and if you’re in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your position to gain a slow and heal.
Nilah.watch: Watch for Nilah E Slipstream closing the gap, and move outside the increased range after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits. When Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, basic attacks miss, so stop trading with basic attacks. Keep your distance from allies in teamfights so you aren’t pulled in by Nilah R Apotheosis.

Senna.build: Use Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Senna’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness keeps undoing Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath’s damage over time, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Senna.combo: When Senna steps forward to collect a soul, hit her with Smolder W Achooo! to slow and explode on her, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, stop trading. Use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath between minion last hits to recover mana.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace misses, look for a chance to close the gap without worrying about its root. You can engage with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap if you can finish safely, but save it as an escape when you need to prepare for a gank. If you need to back away, slow her with Smolder W Achooo! and cross a wall with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. If needed, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet to heal.
Senna.fight: Early on, last-hit with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath instead of starting trades. When Senna steps forward to collect a soul, look for an angle to hit her with Smolder W Achooo!; if it hits, follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, back away.
Senna.laning: Before the first evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath, pull the wave toward your turret and secure last hits and permanent stacks nearby. Watch where Senna’s souls appear, and target her as she steps up to collect one when you can poke safely. Once Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath evolves for the first time and clears waves faster, secure vision and objectives.
Senna.phase: Senna’s range and attack damage grow as she collects mist, so don’t miss chances to contest her soul collection. In the mid game, play around Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath’s evolutions to manage waves and fights; later, fight with your accumulated stacks.
Senna.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and keep using Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the nearest enemy in range. Save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap for survival, and if you’re in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your position to gain a slow and heal.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through minions in a straight line, so avoid the line between Senna and the front minion. Block Senna W Last Embrace with minions, and if it hits, move away from allies before the root spreads. If Senna hits you once, back away to prevent her from landing a second attack and collecting mist.

Seraphine.build: Seraphine’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance instead of armor. If the healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound keeps undoing Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath’s damage over time, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Seraphine.combo: After Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, hit her with Smolder W Achooo! to slow her and gain a stack. Follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If W misses, give up the trade and back away.
Seraphine.escape: You have an opening when Seraphine E Beat Drop is down and Seraphine is separated from allies. If you need to close the gap, you can use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, but it also spends your only escape, so check your way out before going in.
Seraphine.fight: Early on, build growth stacks with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath instead of starting trades. If Seraphine is separated from the allied marksman and Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, you have a chance to trade. Hit with Smolder W Achooo!, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks.
Seraphine.laning: Before the first evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath, pull the wave toward your turret and secure last hits near it. Stacks gained from Q last hits are permanent, so prioritize last hits even if you lose ground in lane. Once Q evolves and starts spreading damage to nearby enemies, use your faster wave clear to secure vision and objectives.
Seraphine.phase: In the mid game, each evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath improves your wave clear and teamfight contribution. Smolder gets stronger later as stacks and items accumulate, so keep building stacks even when behind.
Seraphine.teamfight: Stand behind your frontline, spread out laterally so Seraphine R Encore can’t chain through your allies, and attack the nearest enemy in range with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. Save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap for survival. If you’re in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your position to heal and slow.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you’re slowed, move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine and use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to escape if needed. In teamfights, Seraphine R Encore’s charm travels farther by passing through allied champions, so don’t line up with your allies.

Sivir.build: Hold on early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Sivir’s main damage is physical, and Smolder has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Sivir.combo: Feint an engage, then back off to draw out Sivir E Spell Shield. Next, hit the champion with Smolder W Achooo! to slow them and gain a stack, then use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. Stop trading if W misses.
Sivir.escape: When Sivir E Spell Shield is down, you have a chance to close the gap. Sivir has no blink-type mobility ability, but she can gain movement speed, so use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to engage only when you can get back out safely. E is Smolder’s only escape, so save it if there is a risk of a gank.
Sivir.fight: Early on, focus on last-hitting with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath instead of starting trades. When you fight, first draw out Sivir E Spell Shield, then hit her with Smolder W Achooo! and follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. Back off if W misses.
Sivir.laning: Before Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath gets its first evolution, pull the wave toward your turret and farm last hits and stacks nearby. Sivir clears waves quickly, so if you need to leave lane, push first or make sure an ally is ready to catch the wave. Once Q evolves and you can clear waves faster, secure vision and objectives.
Sivir.phase: In mid game, each evolution of Q improves your wave clear and contribution to fights. Smolder gets strong in late game as stacks and items build up, so the further behind you are, the more you should keep growing through farming rather than fighting.
Sivir.teamfight: Position behind your frontline and use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the closest enemy in range. Even if Sivir E Spell Shield is down, don’t force your way onto Sivir; save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap for survival. If the enemy team groups up, hit the center with Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!; if you’re in danger, cast it on your own position to get healing and a slow.
Sivir.watch: Dodge Sivir Q Boomerang Blade on both its outward and return paths. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so hold your key abilities until it is down. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, her whole team moves faster, so avoid long chases and slow retreats.

Tristana.combo: When trading, hit Tristana first with Smolder W Achooo!, then use Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Tristana jumps onto you with W Rocket Jump, slow her with Smolder W Achooo!, then escape over a wall with E Flap, Flap, Flap. If you need to survive longer, cast R MMOOOMMMM! on your own position to get a slow and healing.
Tristana.escape: Right after Tristana uses W Rocket Jump, you have a chance to close the gap. Before engaging, check whether Tristana R Buster Shot is down, then approach with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. E Flap, Flap, Flap is Smolder’s only escape, so don’t use it to engage if there is a risk of a gank.
Tristana.fight: Early on, last-hit and scale with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. To trade, hit with Smolder W Achooo! to trigger its explosion and gain a stack, then follow with Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If W Achooo! misses, stop trading and back off.
Tristana.laning: Smolder is weak early, so pull the wave toward your turret and farm last hits and permanent stacks with Q Super Scorcher Breath nearby. Tristana E Explosive Charge spreads area damage from minions, so keep your distance from allied minions. Once Q Super Scorcher Breath evolves and you can clear waves faster, secure vision and objectives.
Tristana.phase: Smolder is weak early, so focus on last-hitting and stacking with Q Super Scorcher Breath instead of fighting. In mid game, each evolution of Q Super Scorcher Breath improves your wave clear and teamfight contribution. Smolder has the advantage as the game goes on and he scales, but a fully built Tristana is hard to deal with, so look for a chance to end the game before then.
Tristana.teamfight: Stand behind your frontline and attack the closest enemy in range with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. If Tristana jumps in with W Rocket Jump, survive with the slow from Smolder W Achooo! and E Flap, Flap, Flap. If an ally goes down and Tristana W Rocket Jump could reset, back off immediately.
Tristana.watch: To avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge, don’t stand next to allied minions in lane. If Tristana jumps in with W Rocket Jump, use the slow from Smolder W Achooo! to create distance, and watch out for the stun and knockback from Tristana R Buster Shot. In teamfights, Tristana can use W Rocket Jump again if she gets a takedown, so back off as soon as an ally goes down.

TwistedFate.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Twisted Fate’s ability damage. Also consider movement speed to help you get out of his telegraphed attack areas.
TwistedFate.combo: After Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is down, hit first with Smolder W Achooo! to slow him and gain a Smolder P Dragon Practice stack. Follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, stop trading and back off.
TwistedFate.escape: You have a chance to close the gap after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card has been used and Twisted Fate R Destiny is down. Use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap only when you can approach safely; if danger remains, save it to escape.
TwistedFate.fight: Early on, focus on last-hitting with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath instead of trading. After Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card has been used, if you hit him with Smolder W Achooo!, follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks.
TwistedFate.laning: Before Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath gets its first evolution, pull the wave toward your turret and farm last hits nearby. Stand behind minions against Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. When poking champions with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath, weave it between minion last hits to recover mana.
TwistedFate.phase: Smolder is weak early, so prioritize last-hitting with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and gaining Smolder P Dragon Practice stacks over fighting. In mid game, clear waves around each evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath, then secure vision and objectives. In late game, use your accumulated stacks to deal steady damage from behind your frontline.
TwistedFate.teamfight: From behind your frontline, attack the closest enemy in range with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. Watch for Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card and save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap for survival. If you’re in danger, apply a slow with Smolder W Achooo! and cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! on your own position to heal as you retreat.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate is holding a gold card with W Pick a Card, stay outside his basic attack range.

Twitch.build: Buy a Control Ward early against Twitch Q Ambush. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Twitch P Deadly Venom, and Twitch E Contaminate deals two types of damage, so don’t rely on building just one type of resistance. Consider health and ways to reduce his attack speed.
Twitch.combo: To trade, hit Twitch with Smolder W Achooo!, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Twitch lands several basic attacks or drops Twitch W Venom Cask at your feet, slow him with Smolder W Achooo! and escape over a wall with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. If needed, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! on your own position to slow him and heal.
Twitch.escape: You have a chance to close the gap after dodging the slow from Twitch W Venom Cask and once Twitch Q Ambush’s camouflage ends and his position is revealed. Twitch has no separate escape ability, so you can chase with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. However, E is Smolder’s only escape, so don’t use it to engage if there is still a risk of an ambush.
Twitch.fight: Look to trade after Twitch W Venom Cask misses or after you’ve left its cloud. Hit the champion with Smolder W Achooo! to slow them and gain a stack, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. Back off if W misses, and save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap in case of an ambush.
Twitch.laning: Early on, pull the wave toward your turret and farm last hits with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath nearby to build permanent stacks. Avoid brush where there is no vision and narrow paths, and alert your allies if Twitch disappears. Once Q evolves and you can clear waves faster, secure vision and objectives.
Twitch.phase: Smolder is weak early, so prioritize last-hitting with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and staying alive over fighting. In mid game, each Q evolution improves your wave clear and teamfight contribution, so adjust your movements based on your remaining stacks. Smolder gets strong in late game as stacks and items build up, but keep watching for ambushes with Twitch Q Ambush and the long range of Twitch R Spray and Pray.
Twitch.teamfight: Use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the closest enemy in range from behind your frontline, and save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap for survival. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, don’t line up with your allies; spread out to the side. When Twitch’s camouflage ends or he activates R and takes position, coordinate with your allies on a target and attack. If you’re in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! on your own position.
Twitch.watch: If Twitch disappears from vision with Q Ambush, watch for an ambush and alert your allies. Move out of Twitch W Venom Cask’s cloud immediately. If you’ve been hit by several basic attacks, Twitch E Contaminate can finish you even if you still have health, so use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to create distance.

Varus.build: Hold on early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first, given Varus’s main physical damage and Smolder’s low armor.
Varus.combo: Hit Varus with Smolder W Achooo! to slow him and gain a stack, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. Dodge sideways while Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, and look for an angle to land W.
Varus.escape: If Varus R Chain of Corruption is down and Varus is aiming Varus Q Piercing Arrow, dodge its path, then look for a chance to close the gap with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, but Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is your only escape, so don’t use it to engage if danger remains.
Varus.fight: When you see Varus Q Piercing Arrow being aimed, move sideways out of its path. If you hit with Smolder W Achooo!, trade with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks; back off if W misses.
Varus.laning: Early on, pull the wave toward your turret and farm last hits with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath nearby to build Smolder P Dragon Practice stacks. Even when using Q to poke a champion, weave it between minion last hits to recover mana. Once Q gets its first evolution and starts damaging nearby enemies, use your faster wave clear to secure vision and objectives.
Varus.phase: Smolder is weak early, so don’t force fights with Varus; focus on last-hitting with Q and gaining stacks. In mid game, each evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath improves your wave clear and teamfight contribution. The matchup becomes more favorable for Smolder as stacks and items build up toward late game, so prioritize farming over fighting even when behind.
Varus.teamfight: From behind your frontline, use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the closest enemy in range and save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap for survival. Spread out so Varus R Chain of Corruption doesn’t spread to your allies. While Varus P Living Vengeance is empowered after an ally is killed, don’t move in. If you’re in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! on your own position to slow enemies and heal.
Varus.watch: If you’re hit by a spell while stacks of Varus W Blighted Quiver are on you, you take bonus damage based on your max health, so back off after taking several basic attacks to give the stacks time to wear off. Varus R Chain of Corruption can spread its root to nearby allies, so don’t move next to an ally who has been hit. Healing is reduced on the ground from Varus E Hail of Arrows, so move out of it if you need healing from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!.

Vayne.build: Hold on early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first against Vayne’s main physical damage, but manage your distance to avoid repeated hits from Vayne W Silver Bolts, which armor cannot block.
Vayne.combo: Hit Vayne first with Smolder W Achooo!, then follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. Use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap only when Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn are down and it’s safe to close the gap; otherwise, save it to escape.
Vayne.escape: The moment after Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn are down is your chance to engage, but don’t go in where she can knock you into a wall. To escape, slow her with Smolder W Achooo! and move with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. If you’re in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! on your own position to slow her and heal.
Vayne.fight: Hit Vayne with Smolder W Achooo! to slow her and gain a stack, then trade with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, stop trading, and only close the gap when Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn are down.
Vayne.laning: Early on, pull the wave toward your turret and farm last hits and permanent stacks with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath nearby. Vayne is weak early too, but Smolder is also weak, so prioritize last hits over forcing pressure. Once Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath evolves and you can clear waves faster, secure vision and objectives.
Vayne.phase: Early on, Smolder has few stacks and is weak in lane, so farm safely. In mid game, clear waves and secure objectives around each evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. Smolder gains an advantage once he has stacks, but keep watching for the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts and the stealth during Vayne R Final Hour in late game.
Vayne.teamfight: From behind your frontline, attack the closest enemy in range with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap for survival. Position in an open area so Vayne E Condemn can’t knock you into a wall. During Vayne R Final Hour, use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath when her stealth ends. If enemies group up, hit the center with Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!; if you’re in danger, cast it on your own position.
Vayne.watch: Vayne E Condemn stuns you by knocking you into a wall, so don’t fight with your back to one. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage based on your max health if she keeps hitting the same target, so create distance after taking several hits, before her next attack.

Xayah.build: Hold on early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Xayah’s main damage is physical, so build armor first.
Xayah.combo: Hit Xayah with Smolder W Achooo! to slow her and gain a stack, then use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. After trading, move to the side to avoid the path of feathers recalled by Xayah E Bladecaller.
Xayah.escape: You can approach with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap if you’re already out of Xayah E Bladecaller’s root path. If you’re worried about a gank or counterattack, save E to escape.
Xayah.fight: Xayah’s feathers build up if you fight her for too long, so keep trades short and change position. If Smolder W Achooo! hits, follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks; back off if it misses.
Xayah.laning: Early on, pull the wave toward your turret and farm last hits with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath nearby. Stacks from Q last hits are permanent, so prioritize last hits even if you lose a trade. Once Q evolves and starts damaging nearby enemies, clear the wave and take control.
Xayah.phase: Smolder is weak early, so prioritize safe farming and stacking over fighting Xayah. In mid game, each evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath improves your wave clear and contribution to fights. Smolder gets strong as stacks and items build up in late game, so keep farming even when behind.
Xayah.teamfight: From behind your frontline, keep using Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the closest enemy in range. If Xayah R Featherstorm is available, don’t force an engage on her, and save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap for survival. When in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! on your own position to slow enemies and heal.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if you’re hit by three or more returning feathers, so move to the side immediately if feathers line up between you and Xayah. Don’t initiate by going in deep while Xayah R Featherstorm is available.

Yasuo.build: Hold on early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Yasuo’s main damage is physical, and Smolder has low armor, so build armor first. Armor doesn’t block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Poke off Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first, then slow him with Smolder W Achooo! when Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado is down. If Smolder W Achooo! hits, follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks you, go around it or save your key abilities until it disappears.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado is down is your chance to engage. Look to go in with crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath is available again. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can be used again, so don’t use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to chase just because E was used once.
Yasuo.fight: Poke off Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield before trading. Right after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado misses, he briefly has no way to knock you up, so hit him with Smolder W Achooo! and follow with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, give up the trade and back off.
Yasuo.laning: Early on, last-hit minions with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath to build Smolder P Dragon Practice stacks. Before your first evolution, pull the wave toward your turret and farm nearby, while watching the wave so you don’t leave too many minions for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to use as stepping stones. When Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath evolves for the first time and you can clear waves faster, secure vision and objectives.
Yasuo.phase: In mid game, each evolution of Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath improves your wave clear and teamfight contribution. Smolder gets strong in late game as stacks and items build up, so the further behind you are, the more you should rely on farming to keep scaling.
Yasuo.teamfight: From behind your frontline, keep using Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the closest enemy in range. If Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks your way, go around it or save your key abilities, and dodge Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado to the side. Save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap for survival; if you’re in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! on your own position to slow enemies and heal.
Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo lands Q Steel Tempest twice, his next tornado knocks you airborne, so watch for its sound and effects and dodge sideways. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to approach, so be careful about your distance where there are many minions. Save your key abilities or go around Yasuo W Wind Wall.

Zeri.build: Build Cloth Armor early to withstand her damage, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser deal mostly physical damage, so build armor first.
Zeri.combo: Hit Zeri with Smolder W Achooo! to slow her and gain a stack, then follow up with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, give up the trade and back off. If Zeri E Spark Surge is down and you can still escape safely, use Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to close the gap and take advantage of the opening.
Zeri.escape: The moment after Zeri uses E Spark Surge is your window to engage. If Zeri W Ultrashock Laser also misses, hit her with Smolder W Achooo! to slow her, then close the gap. Don’t push her toward a wall while Zeri E Spark Surge is available.
Zeri.fight: Early on, build stacks of Smolder P Dragon Practice and avoid taking risky fights. Right after Zeri uses E Spark Surge is a chance to close the gap, but Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is also needed to escape, so use it only when you can get out safely. If Zeri has activated R Lightning Crash, stop chasing.
Zeri.laning: Let the wave push toward you and farm near your turret with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. Smolder P Dragon Practice stacks don’t disappear, so don’t miss last hits even if you lose ground in lane. Once Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath gets its first evolution and starts damaging nearby enemies, clear the wave and secure vision and objectives.
Zeri.phase: Smolder is weak early, so farm and survive with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. In the mid game, increase your wave clear and contribution to fights as Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath evolves. In the late game, Smolder becomes strong with stacks and items, but once Zeri has her core items, her mobility makes her harder to pick off.
Zeri.teamfight: From behind your frontline, use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the nearest enemy in range. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, don’t chase; save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to survive. If Zeri gets close, slow her with Smolder W Achooo!, and when you’re in danger, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! on your own position to heal and slow enemies.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads when it hits terrain, so avoid standing with a wall behind you or facing her in a narrow passage. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when crossing walls, so don't push her toward one. After Zeri activates R Lightning Crash, her movement speed increases, so don't chase her on foot.

Ziggs.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can walk out of the warned blast area. If you need resistance, build magic resistance against Ziggs’s magic damage.
Ziggs.combo: After Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, hit a champion with Smolder W Achooo! to slow them and gain a stack, then follow up with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and basic attacks. If Smolder W Achooo! misses, stop trading and back off.
Ziggs.escape: While Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, you can approach along a route clear of mines. If things get dangerous, slow him with Smolder W Achooo! and escape over a wall you chose in advance with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap; if needed, cast Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! at your feet to heal.
Ziggs.fight: Early on, focus on last hits with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath instead of starting trades. Close the gap when Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down and you have a route clear of mines.
Ziggs.laning: Before Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath gets its first evolution, let the wave push toward you and farm for last hits and stacks near your turret. Hold on while dodging Ziggs's poke, and once Q starts damaging nearby enemies, use your faster wave clear to secure vision and objectives.
Ziggs.phase: Smolder is weak early, so focus on building permanent stacks with Q last hits rather than fighting Ziggs. In the mid game, your wave clear and contribution to fights improve each time Q evolves. In the late game, Smolder becomes strong as stacks and items build up, so keep farming even when you’re behind.
Ziggs.teamfight: From behind your frontline, consistently use Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath on the nearest enemy in range. Position yourself to avoid Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, and save Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap to survive. Don’t group together in one spot where Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb can hit everyone.
Ziggs.watch: Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield slows you if you step on it, making it easier for him to hit you with other abilities, so go around it or wait for it to disappear. When the warning area for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb appears, move away from the center of the blast even if you can’t dodge it completely.
